member.name: T:Gtk.Windows.FormsDesigner.configProperties
member.summary: Represents configuration properties that control runtime serialization and application path settings.
member.remarks: This class provides options for enabling unsafe binary formatter serialization and for setting application paths via host policy. These properties correspond to runtime configuration switches and may affect application security and startup behavior. Use caution when enabling unsafe serialization features, as they may introduce security risks.

member.name: P:Gtk.Windows.FormsDesigner.configProperties.EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that indicates whether support for unsafe BinaryFormatter serialization is enabled.
member.remarks: Enabling unsafe BinaryFormatter serialization allows deserialization of types using BinaryFormatter, which can introduce security vulnerabilities. It is recommended to disable this setting unless compatibility with legacy data is required. Use with caution in production environments.

member.name: P:Gtk.Windows.FormsDesigner.configProperties.SetAppPaths
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether application paths are configured for .NET Core host policy resolution.

member.name: T:Gtk.Windows.FormsDesigner.GtkWindowsForms
member.summary: Represents an MSBuild task that configures runtime dependencies for Windows Forms applications targeting .NET Core or .NET 5+ on GTK platforms.
member.remarks: This task generates or updates designer dependency and runtime configuration files required for Windows Forms projects on GTK environments. It ensures that the necessary framework references are present for proper runtime execution. All required properties must be set before execution. This task is typically used in build processes to support cross-platform Windows Forms development.

member.name: M:Gtk.Windows.FormsDesigner.GtkWindowsForms.Execute
member.summary: Executes the task to ensure required designer configuration files are present and updated for the specified target framework.
member.remarks: This method creates or updates designer-related JSON configuration files in the specified object path if they do not exist or require modification. It ensures that the configuration reflects the current target framework and includes necessary runtime options. The method always returns true, indicating successful execution, even if some operations are skipped due to existing files or read-only attributes.
member.returns: true if the designer configuration files are successfully created or updated; otherwise, false.

member.summary: Rotates the specified value left by the specified number of bits. Similar in behavior to the x86 instruction ROL.
member.param: The number of bits to rotate by. Any value outside the range [0..31] is treated as congruent mod 32.
